statements.status_notes: uuid@9.0.1 is vulnerable to CVE-2026-41907 (MEDIUM severity, silent partial writes into caller-provided buffers in v3/v5/v6 functions). The fix is available in uuid@11.1.1. However, upgrading from uuid@9.x to uuid@11.x is a major version jump that would require significant testing and may introduce breaking changes in transitive dependencies. The vulnerability affects applications that pass external buffers to uuid v3/v5/v6 functions with attacker-controlled offsets or undersized buffers; langfuse's typical usage does not expose this attack surface.

uuid@11.1.0 is vulnerable to CVE-2026-41907 (MEDIUM severity, silent partial writes into caller-provided buffers in v3/v5/v6 functions). The fix is available in uuid@11.1.1. However, upgrading is blocked because oci-common@2.127.0 (a transitive dependency) deep-imports uuid/v1, which was removed in uuid@11.x. Upgrading uuid would break oci-common at runtime. A fix requires either an oci-common update that removes the uuid/v1 deep-import or a workaround that maintains compatibility. The vulnerability affects applications that pass external buffers to uuid v3/v5/v6 functions with attacker-controlled offsets or undersized buffers; langfuse's typical usage does not expose this attack surface.
